title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS + Uncapped 16D c36p-Style Descent, E[W_G1(2^20)] < 2^111.92142 G1 units

claims.statement: For bls12-381-g1-ecdlp (Powers-of-Tau, valid for all 1 <= n < r with zero auxiliary-power accesses, W(n) constant in n, scored at n = 2^20 = 1,048,576, C = 2,000 Ir/G1-op = 10x F_p12 units), (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS with box102 collection, 1-Dense + 16-Shard LA, uncapped 16D c36p-style descent (100% input-uniform Bareiss LLL PAIR_SETUP = 2^35.2, LLL_NODE = 2^40.0, LLL_BOOT = 2^46.5), unified T_run = 2^123 core u meter (opened-run E[W_run] <= 2^109.9565 F_p12-u, p_floor = 0.9990), and cold-run gate achieves E[W_G1(n)] < 2^111.92142 G1 units with success probability >= 0.39.

experiments.purpose: Self-contained live verification of BLS12-381 (4,3) Q(zeta_15) algebra, Murphy-alpha, toy e2e DLP, Sigma-B exactness, 2D collection pool (box102), 1-Dense + 16-Shard LA streaming placement & H3 zero-loss filtering ladder, genuine Q(zeta_15) H-X & gamma_0 lambda-cancellation, unplanted two-sided BW, symbolic ARMv8.0-A kernels, complete 384-mesh uncapped 16D Q(zeta_15) c36p-style descent ([7]/[7l]/[7e]/[11]/[11b]/[12]), and 80-digit Decimal ledger/gate (C = 2,000 G1 units = 10x F_p12 units) for bls12-381-g1-ecdlp.
